numeric_policy.aspect_affinity: after weighted primary attributes: clamp(1 + affinity_percent/200, 1.0, 1.5)
numeric_policy.dot: tick at affected target start of turn; decrement after tick; refresh max remaining/new; strongest equivalent only
numeric_policy.overflow: once per affected actor per resolved action on threshold crossing; recursion guard; lock removal re-evaluates threshold
numeric_policy.action_economy: one action point per Active skill; no extra actions
numeric_policy.p_growth: CAPABILITY_P_GROWTH is Alya-only; validate before costs commit
numeric_policy.finishers: encounter-permitted outcomes only; no implicit Defeat/global victory
